## Browse Special or Preview

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

base_dir <- "."

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Sections in display order
# ------------------------------------------------------------

section_dirs <- c(
  "Season Trends",
  "Match Previews",
  "Specials"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Thumbnails
# ------------------------------------------------------------

section_thumbs <- c(
  "Season Trends"  = "Images/Premier-league-ball.png",
  "Match Previews" = "Images/Premier-league-ball.png",
  "Specials"       = "Images/Premier-league-ball.png"
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Descriptions
# ------------------------------------------------------------

section_descriptions <- c(
  "Season Trends" =
    "Explore season-wide trends, team performance and league analysis.",

  "Match Previews" =
    "Match-by-match previews, opposition analysis and key performance indicators.",

  "Specials" =
    "Special reports and standalone football analysis."
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Find target
#
# Season Trends:
#   Link DIRECTLY to its dashboard HTML.
#
# Match Previews / Specials:
#   Link to their folder/index.
# ------------------------------------------------------------

find_target <- function(section) {

  section_path <- file.path(base_dir, section)

  if (!dir.exists(section_path)) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  # ---- SEASON TRENDS: direct dashboard link ----

  if (section == "Season Trends") {

    docs_dir <- file.path(section_path, "docs")

    if (!dir.exists(docs_dir)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    html_files <- list.files(
      docs_dir,
      pattern = "\\.html$",
      full.names = FALSE
    )

    if (length(html_files) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    # Same behaviour as a normal matchday dashboard
    html_file <- sort(html_files)[1]

    return(
      file.path(
        section,
        "docs",
        html_file
      )
    )
  }

  # ---- MATCH PREVIEWS / SPECIALS ----

  # If rendered index.html exists
  index_html <- file.path(section_path, "index.html")

  if (file.exists(index_html)) {
    return(file.path(section, "index.html"))
  }

  # Otherwise link to folder
  paste0(section, "/")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Create cards
# ------------------------------------------------------------

cards <- vapply(section_dirs, function(section) {

  target <- find_target(section)

  if (is.null(target)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  # Clean URL
  target <- gsub("\\\\", "/", target)
  url <- utils::URLencode(target)

  thumb <- section_thumbs[[section]]
  description <- section_descriptions[[section]]

  sprintf(
    paste0(
      '<div class="g-col-12 g-col-md-6 g-col-lg-4">\n',
      '  <div class="card season-card">\n',
      '    <div class="season-card-media">\n',
      '      <img src="%s" class="card-img-top img-fluid" alt="%s thumbnail">\n',
      '    </div>\n',
      '    <div class="card-body">\n',
      '      <h3><a href="%s">%s</a></h3>\n',
      '      <div class="text-muted">%s</div>\n',
      '    </div>\n',
      '  </div>\n',
      '</div>\n'
    ),
    thumb,
    section,
    url,
    section,
    description
  )

}, character(1))

cards <- cards[!is.na(cards)]

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Output
# ------------------------------------------------------------

output <- paste0(
  '<div class="grid">\n',
  paste(cards, collapse = "\n"),
  '\n</div>\n'
)

knitr::asis_output(output)
```
